description: This file defines the LayerGroup class for managing collections of map layers in the Leaflet library, including methods for adding, removing, and iterating over layers.

classes.name: LayerGroup
classes.description: A class extending Layer to manage a group of layers, allowing batch operations and map integration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the LayerGroup with optional layers and options.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to the group and map.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from the group and map.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a layer is in the group.

methods.name: clearLayers
methods.description: Removes all layers from the group.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls a method on all layers in the group.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds all layers to the map.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes all layers from the map.

methods.name: eachLayer
methods.description: Iterates over each layer, calling a provided function.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a layer by internal ID.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Returns all layers in the group.

methods.name: getLayerId
methods.description: Returns internal ID for a layer.
